app.name: DAILY
app.tagline: Plan with intention, focus on what matters, and make every day count.
app.description: A digital workspace designed for university students. Bring assignments, notes, deadlines, and personal goals together in one flexible place.

landing.heroTitle: Plan with intention, focus on what matters, and make every day count.
landing.heroSubtitle: Inspired by modular platforms like Notion, adapted to university needs. Bring assignments, notes, calendars, and personal goals together in one place.
landing.feature1Desc: Organize assignments by subject, deadlines, and priorities without losing track of your exams.
landing.feature2Desc: Take class notes, study summaries, and personal ideas linked to your subjects in a clean editor.
landing.feature3Desc: Visualize your recurring classes, shifts, and commitments synchronized with your upcoming deadlines.
landing.feature4Desc: Allocate tasks into available free time and use the calm Pomodoro timer for deep study sessions.
landing.feature5Desc: Choose from seven themes: Pink Dawn, Dark Dusk, Matcha & Sage, Espresso & Parchment, Nordic Slate, Lavender & Amethyst, and University Indigo.
landing.workflow1Desc: Register your courses for the semester and personalize your visual theme.
landing.workflow2Desc: Create deadlines, exams, and projects with automatic reminder notifications.
landing.workflow3Desc: Map your fixed courses and let the planner algorithm suggest realistic study blocks.
landing.workflow4Desc: Select which widgets to show and keep only what matters in view today.
landing.previewCaption: DAILY workspace: a clear, personalized overview of your student life.
landing.footerText: DAILY — Designed to make university life easier, calmer, and more organized.
